description: Returns how a player's actual fantasy points compared with his projections: the average deviation and each week's projected vs actual. Use it to judge boom/bust tendencies or whether a player keeps beating (or missing) his projection. Basic plan and above.

player_id.description: GridIron player id, "First Last#POS", matched case-insensitively. Defenses are "Team Name#DST". Unsure of the id? Call search_players first.
player_id.title: Player Id

season.description: Season year, 2020 or later. Default: the current season.
season.title: Season

error.description: Present only when the call failed: what went wrong.

note.description: A sentence for the user saying which plan is needed.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure reason, e.g. basic_required or pro_required.

required_plan.description: The plan that unlocks this data: basic or pro.

status.description: HTTP status of the failed API call.

weekly_deviations.description: Per week: actual vs projected points.
